stage: Part 2 Section 4A: Specify validation-test ranking agreement methodology
scope: Specification and audit design only. No ranking computation, analytical CSVs, numeric results, charts, or scientific conclusions generated.

join_specification.mode_handling: mode is retained from validation_log and is not part of the unique baseline test key
join_specification.baseline_test_key_uniqueness: baseline test table is unique on experiment × target_project × seed × model
join_specification.validation_to_baseline_mapping: each baseline test row is used in a controlled manner across three validation modes
join_specification.join_cardinality: 600 validation rows join to 200 unique baseline test rows

tie_policy.winner_set_handling: preserve all tied candidates in winner set
tie_policy.deterministic_display: constant candidate ordering allowed for display only, not for winner set determination
tie_policy.tolerance_winner_set_construction: tolerance winner set is not built via pairwise chaining or candidate ordering

rank_policy.tie_handling: ties are managed with average ranks
rank_policy.spearman_computation: Spearman correlation computed on two rank vectors of four candidates
rank_policy.correlation_tie_policy: main correlations are based on tolerance-aware ranks
rank_policy.tolerance_group_construction: tolerance groups are built by comparison to ordered performance levels
rank_policy.deterministic_order_forbidden: no deterministic candidate order should break real ties
rank_policy.canonical_order_purpose: alignment and serialization only, not for tie-breaking

exact_rank_algorithm.step_1: compute utility for each candidate based on metric direction
exact_rank_algorithm.step_2: sort candidates by utility in descending order
exact_rank_algorithm.step_3: group candidates with exactly equal utility values
exact_rank_algorithm.step_4: assign rank to each group as average ordinal positions of its members
exact_rank_algorithm.rank_1_best: rank 1 always represents best performance (highest utility)

tolerance_aware_rank_algorithm.step_1: compute utility for each candidate based on metric direction
tolerance_aware_rank_algorithm.step_2: sort candidates by utility in descending order
tolerance_aware_rank_algorithm.step_3: start with the best ungrouped candidate as anchor
tolerance_aware_rank_algorithm.step_4: anchor_utility is the fixed reference value for the current group
tolerance_aware_rank_algorithm.step_5: subsequent candidates join the same group only if: anchor_utility - candidate_utility <= 1e-12
tolerance_aware_rank_algorithm.step_6: comparison to the last group member is forbidden
tolerance_aware_rank_algorithm.step_8: when the first candidate is outside anchor tolerance, close the group
tolerance_aware_rank_algorithm.step_9: next candidate becomes anchor for new group
tolerance_aware_rank_algorithm.step_10: assign rank to each group as average ordinal positions of its members
tolerance_aware_rank_algorithm.candidate_order_forbidden: candidate order must not be used to extend tie groups

synthetic_audit_example.expected_result: first and second candidates in one tolerance group, third candidate in next group
synthetic_audit_example.non_chaining_rule: even if distance between second and third candidates is less than or equal to tolerance, chaining must not group all three together

candidate_vector_alignment.alignment_purpose: coordinate alignment for correlation computation, not tie-breaking
candidate_vector_alignment.spearman_basis: computed on two tolerance-aware average-rank vectors with fixed alignment order
candidate_vector_alignment.kendall_basis: Kendall tau-b computed on the same two tolerance-aware rank vectors with fixed alignment order
candidate_vector_alignment.missing_or_extra_candidates_forbidden: no missing or extra candidates allowed in rank vectors

strict_top1_agreement_exact.definition: true only when both validation and test winner sets (exact) are single-member and contain the same candidate

strict_top1_agreement_tolerance.definition: true only when both validation and test winner sets (tolerance) are single-member and contain the same candidate

winner_set_equal_exact.definition: validation winner set (exact) exactly equals test winner set (exact)

winner_set_equal_tolerance.definition: validation winner set (tolerance) exactly equals test winner set (tolerance)

winner_set_jaccard_exact.definition: Jaccard similarity between validation winner set (exact) and test winner set (exact)

winner_set_jaccard_tolerance.definition: Jaccard similarity between validation winner set (tolerance) and test winner set (tolerance)

winner_set_any_overlap_exact.definition: intersection of validation winner set (exact) and test winner set (exact) is non-empty

winner_set_any_overlap_tolerance.definition: intersection of validation winner set (tolerance) and test winner set (tolerance) is non-empty

selected_candidate_in_test_winner_set_ex.definition: mode-selected candidate is in test winner set (exact)

selected_candidate_in_test_winner_set_to.definition: mode-selected candidate is in test winner set (tolerance)

spearman_correlation.definition: correlation on ranks of four candidates, with average ranks for ties

selected_candidate_test_rank.definition: rank of mode-selected candidate in test ranking for the same metric, average rank if tied
selected_candidate_test_rank.tolerance_group_handling: if candidate is in multi-member tolerance group, average rank of that group is recorded

undefined_correlation_policy.condition: correlation undefined when validation rank vector or test rank vector has zero variance (all four candidates have the same rank in one of the vectors)

interpretation_limits.seed_assumption: event-level analysis unit includes seed: experiment × target_project × seed × mode. For descriptive aggregation, the five seeds are repeated, non-independent runs nested within experiment × target_project × mode × metric. Seeds are not treated as iid observations for inferential testing.
interpretation_limits.seed_nesting: event rows include seed. Summary may perform descriptive aggregation across seeds. No p-value or iid confidence interval will be produced.
interpretation_limits.test_data_usage: test data will only be used for post-selection evaluation

selected_candidate_provenance.source: AQRPE row corresponding to mode in repeated_all_results.csv
selected_candidate_provenance.expected_uniqueness: exactly one AQRPE row must exist for each analysis unit and mapped model

validation_verification.candidate_domain_check: selected_candidate must be in candidate domain
validation_verification.validation_row_existence: exactly one validation row must exist for the same experiment, target_project, seed, mode, and selected_candidate
validation_verification.objective_direction: val_selection_score is treated as higher-is-better objective for all three modes
validation_verification.winner_set_membership: selected candidate must be member of tolerance-aware maximum set for val_selection_score of the same mode
validation_verification.multi_member_winner_set_handling: if objective winner set has multiple members, scalar selected candidate must be one of them
validation_verification.tie_break_exclusion: tie-break scalar from canonical AQRPE row must not be used for winner sets of 14 metrics

selected_candidate_provenance.test_leakage_prohibition: no test metric is used to extract or validate candidate selection
